results.name: ambiguous_word_foil_choice_rate
results.description: Rate of choosing non-matching foil objects on utterance trials where the heard word is true of two or more objects.

results.name: unambiguous_word_accuracy
results.description: Rate of choosing the uniquely matching referent on utterance trials where the heard word is true of exactly one object.

results.name: size_prior_max_feature_rate
results.description: Rate of choosing the object with the maximal feature count on mumble trials in the size experiment.

results.name: scalar_intermediate_competitor_rate
results.description: Rate of choosing intermediate competitors on utterance trials where three or more objects match the heard word with a strict hierarchy of feature counts.

results.name: speakers_l2_target_choice_rate
results.description: Rate of choosing the L2 target object on utterance trials in the speakers experiment where the competitor has an alternative unambiguous word.

results.name: twin_uniform_singleton_choice_rate
results.description: Rate of choosing the unique singleton object on utterance trials in the E9 twins experiment where the heard word is true of all objects.

results.name: standard_scalar_logical_choice_rate
results.description: Rate of choosing the logical competitor on three-object scalar implicature displays with one foil, one target, and one competitor matching the heard word.

results.name: two_object_pragmatic_target_rate
results.description: Rate of choosing the pragmatic target with fewer features on utterance trials with exactly two objects that both match the heard word.
